name: javascript-number-to-word-processor-monorepo
description: Monorepo for JSnumberToWordProcessor v4 - the core NPM library and the Next.js quick-usage UI.
author: Saheed Odulaja

scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:ui
scripts.dev:ui: npm run build:core && npm run dev --workspace @jsnumber/ui
scripts.verify: npm run build:core && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
